title: A Killer Clown Strikes
description: In Florida, a wealthy small businesswoman is shot in the face by a clown delivering flowers and balloons; this shocking crime goes unsolved for 27 years.

title: A Killer Trick-or-Treater
description: Doreen and Charles Erbert live a charmed life with their 4-year-old daughter Deanna in San Jose, Calif.; then everything comes to a violent end on Halloween night when Doreen is stabbed to death by a masked trick-or-treater.

title: Dead Silent
description:
S03 E05 — Taken for a Ride
Reeling from a recent breakup, 23-year-old Jacey McWilliams is down in the dumps until she meets a hot, new man; just as they're about to take their relationship to the next level, it takes a horrific turn.

title: Dead Silent
description:
S03 E01 — Picture of Evil
A picture-perfect dinner for two dissolves into a nightmare for college sophomore Dominique Nicky Hurd and a classmate after they become the targets of a deranged predator.

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
description:
S23 E09 — No Escape
A young woman's disappearance marks the beginning of a heartbreaking murder mystery; a clue discovered by a child could be the key to catching his mother's killer.

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
description:
S23 E14 — A Cracked Alibi
If investigators can't find the crack in their suspect's seemingly airtight alibi, a cold-blooded killer will elude justice.

title: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
description:
S01 E01 — Indoctrination
After Andrea Yates' horrifying act, her dark preoccupation emerges; a secretive cult, twisted teachings, and followers drawn into a growing web of control.

title: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
description:
S01 E02 — The Horror Within
Woroniecki's teachings reportedly isolate followers and equate salvation with submission; this ideology is linked to Andrea Yates, who committed an act that shocked the nation.

title: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
description:
S01 E03 — Revelation
Andrea Yates faces two trials in the aftermath of the drownings, exposing the preacher's lingering influence; as Woroniecki deflects blame onto Rusty, a juror quietly reveals that his teachings shaped the verdict, raising questions of accountability.

title: Toxic
description:
S02 E03 — Blame It On Daddy
When Jason marries Andria, he believes her story of survival and struggle; as their marriage collapses, her web of lies grows - false accusations, fabricated abuse claims and a campaign to destroy him, culminating in an armed home invasion.

title: Toxic
description:
S02 E04 — A Living Nightmare
Mandy marries a man twice her age and their relationship quickly turns suffocating and volatile; as the abuse escalates, she searches for answers until the truth emerges, and she fights to be believed and hold him accountable.

title: Toxic
description:
S02 E05 — The Chosen One
When a teenage girl in a tightly controlled religious community falls prey to her charismatic pastor, she's told it is love; years later, she realizes it is abuse and takes on those in the church who would rather destroy her than face the truth.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S12 E03 — Sleeping With the Enemy
When Sarita Anderson begins feeling ill, she thinks it's just the flu at first; she never suspects that the man pretending to love and nurse her back to health is actually the monster responsible.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S11 E01 — Locked in the Closet
Alice Jenkins locks Jesse Ewing in a closet; Jesse realizes that if he and his siblings do not find a way to escape, they will surely die.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S11 E06 — Keeping My Brother's Secret
When Steven Crittenden confesses to his brother, Bryant, and then swears him to secrecy, Bryant faces the toughest decision of his life: whether to keep the secret and risk letting a murderer get away with it or tell the truth and betray his family.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S11 E03 — I Will Always Be Scared of Him
From the moment Deborah Williamson meets her stepson, David Shafer, she feels something unsettling about him; when her warnings about his frightening behavior go unheeded, the devastation he ultimately wreaks goes beyond her imagination.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S11 E08 — Divorce? Never. Murder? Maybe.
When Vernon Jensen's ex-wife proves how far she'll go to get him back, his family is fractured beyond repair, and the little girl who was to be his stepdaughter never sees him again; now Jade Scotton is an adult and wants answers only Vernon has.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S11 E02 — What if He Gets Out?
When Amy Chesler calls 911 to report what her brother, Jesse Winnick, has confessed to, she doesn't know whether to believe him; Jesse's always been a liar, and Amy doesn't understand what he is capable of until she walks in and sees it for herself.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S19 E07 — The Granny Killer
Nora Lapella escapes her abusive husband, Edwin Mike Kaprat, with her two sons; police arrest him for killing at least five people and suspect him in additional deaths; only then does she realize how lucky she and her children are to be alive.

title: What Happened in the Haight House?
description: For nearly two decades, Tausha Haight endures emotional and psychological abuse from her seemingly perfect husband, Michael, who hides a darker reality; when she fights to leave, escalating red flags put Tausha and her five children in danger.

title: Toxic
description:
S02 E06 — Love and Rage
Yeardley Love is days from graduation when her UVA lacrosse player boyfriend, George Huguely, breaks into her room and kills her; Elizabeth Chambers examines the warning signs, missed intervention, and the legacy her family builds from tragedy.

description:
Death Before Dishonor
Detectives rush to a Kansas City bar after a mass shooting leaves the entire country reeling; with suspects on the run and chilling footage emerging, investigators race to uncover the truth before more blood is shed.

title: Real PD: Kansas City
description:
S01 E04 — Run to Grandma
Four separate gas stations are violently robbed at gun point by a masked man in one night; detectives race to catch the robber and get justice for the terrified local community.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S01 E01 — Target on Her Back
Caroline Nosal, a 24-year-old grocery store worker, befriends co-worker Christopher O'Kroley, but she soon complains to store management about O'Kroley's behavior leading to a tragic outcome.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S01 E06 — Living a Lie
Bob Peterson invites himself over to his co-workers Gene and Jaye-Jaye Thurnau's new home to give them a housewarming present; later, Jaye-Jaye leaves the guys alone to run an errand, during which time they vanish.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S01 E02 — Unfriendly Community
On a June morning, a cleaning lady finds property manager Melinda Schaefer stabbed to death in her ransacked office.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S01 E03 — The Evil Inside
Kerri Harris and her friend discover a camera secreted in the restroom at work; while police examine the evidence, Harris is stabbed to death in her office with her co-workers just a few feet away.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E02 — Appalachian Vendetta
Once-friendly neighbors on a mountain road become sworn enemies after one family calls police about a theft -- violating the unspoken tradition of leaving authorities out of disputes; years of conflict finally culminate with shots fired.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E05 — Other People's Property
The mountain road between them fails to keep two long-time neighbors from tormenting each other; seemingly small events bring their decadeslong hostility to a bloody boil, and property lines become battle lines in a fight to the death.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E09 — Blood on the Lawn
A five-year relationship between neighbors falls apart when one borrows the other's lawnmower and supposedly returns it broken; camaraderie morphs into rage, threats, and physical violence until a bloody murder devastates the community.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E11 — Under Surveillance
A man returns to his hometown after years away; he receives a warm welcome from the residents until the noise from a new neighbor's puppies turns him into a vengeful menace who goes to war with the entire community.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E06 — A Clockwork Killing
An apartment-dwelling family finds their peace and quiet shattered when a loud neighbor moves into the unit directly overhead; the conflict engulfs both sides resulting in flying fists, drawn weapons, and a man left bleeding out in the hallway.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E01 — Blizzard of Blood
A single woman and her two young sons believe they have found a perfect new apartment, but their overbearing landlord and neighbor soon turns their idyllic situation into a living hell of arguments and intimidation that finally ends in bloodshed.

title: Deadly Women
description:
S14 E13 — Making a Killing
Women who commit crimes out of greed.

title: Deadly Women
description:
S14 E12 — Clean Hands, Dirty Deeds
Crime experts explore the motives and modus operandi of female killers; while males are often driven by anger, impulse and destruction, women usually have more complex, long-term reasons to kill.

title: Deadly Women
description:
S14 E10 — Soulless
Eyes are the windows to the soul, except for these three demented women.

title: Deadly Women
description:
S14 E01 — Tainted Love
Ciera Harp snaps after realizing aspiring rapper Rahim Grant will never be hers; Linda Ricchio's possessive behavior wears thin with boyfriend Ron Ruse; grandmother Loretta Burroughs marries her high school sweetheart, Danny, then he disappears.

title: Caught in the Net
description:
S02 E01 — The Man in the Mirror
Two young men are shot dead in the middle of the night, and the only witness has no idea who the gunman is; Omaha PD detectives turn to digital forensics, hoping hidden data buried in the victims' cell phones can help track down the killer.

title: Caught in the Net
description:
S02 E03 — Digital Crumbs
When family man Ricky Saxton is found murdered, investigators turn to a forensic data specialist at the FBI to help locate a missing piece of the puzzle; a deleted snapshot buried deep within the data leads them to Ricky's killer.

title: Caught in the Net
description:
S02 E04 — The Dog Knows
When police find 64-year-old nurse Athena Valentiny brutally murdered in her home, investigators follow the digital trail her killer left behind; they cross-reference the digital evidence with surveillance video to reveal who took her life.

title: Caught in the Net
description:
S02 E06 — Monsters Are Real
After the murder of young mother Morgan Ashley Fox, investigators don't have much physical evidence; with numerous suspects in the frame, digital evidence reveals the secrets of a monster hiding in plain sight.

title: Body Cam
description:
S09 E04 — Fire and Fury
A man holds his child hostage in California; officers negotiate with him, but he sets the house on fire; in Florida, criminals break into a jewelry store; officers must catch them before they escape with over $70,000 worth of jewelry.

title: Body Cam
description:
S09 E05 — Fight, Flight or Flee
In Ohio, cops face a hostage situation with a fugitive willing to go to extremes; in Maryland, police catch armed robbers in the act, and they run from the law; in Indiana, police risk it all to save circus animals inside a burning truck.

title: Body Cam
description:
S08 E02 — Nowhere to Hide
In California, an argument in a bar leads to a hostage situation; in New Mexico, a shoplifter fires upon an officer before going on the run; in Wisconsin, a suspect disappears into the frozen wilderness after flipping his car.

title: Body Cam
description:
S09 E08 — Deadly Disappearance
In Oregon, a murder suspect flees from the courthouse sparking a manhunt; in Arizona, an art heist has officers reaching new heights.

title: Body Cam
description:
S08 E08 — He Shot Me!
In New Mexico, a female officer pulls over a truck, but when she approaches, shots ring out; in Ohio, officers surround a house where men take a victim at gunpoint, the suspects escape with a second hostage, and a full-scale manhunt ensues.

title: Body Cam
description:
S08 E01 — Race Against Time
In Wisconsin, a terrified woman wakes up in her car and finds a thief is stealing it, sparking a high-speed police pursuit; a home invasion in Utah turns into a fire rescue, when a man sets the house alight with the residents still inside.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E16 — Who Took Heather?
A 13-year-old girl goes missing, sending Kenda's city into a panic; just when investigators think they've got a handle on what is going on, a cryptic letter to the district attorney's office suggests that the girl isn't the only victim.
